title: Book Two · Chapter 37: At the Field Gate
story:
The page arrives on Tuesday morning.

Miss Wu gives one to each child. There are no pictures at the top. Only a title and a short story.

“Read the story first,” she says. “Then answer the three questions. Keep your own page in front of you.”

Ronan writes his name. Leo writes his too. Their pencils make two short sounds against the desk.

The story is about a brother and sister. They take two kites to a field. The girl's line is red. The boy's line is blue.

A dog runs between them near a fence. The blue line comes loose. The boy stops to tie it again.

“Go to the field gate,” he tells his sister. “Wait there for me.”

The girl goes ahead. She waits beside the gate with the red line in her hand. The boy stays by the fence until his blue line is ready.

Ronan reads the page quickly. He remembers his own kites. He can tie the lines himself.

He looks at the questions.

Who waits at the field gate?

Whose line is blue?

Why does the brother stop?

He writes the boy for the first answer. For the second, he writes the brother. Then he explains the loose blue line.

He puts the pencil down.

Jun is still reading. Mei is writing on the last part of her page. Leo looks at the story again.

Ronan lifts his own sheet a little. He wants to show Miss Wu his finished page.

But she is helping a child near the door. That child is asking about a word in the instructions. Miss Wu points to the top of the page and speaks quietly.

Ronan looks at his first answer. He remembers a red line beside a gate.

Perhaps he should look at that part again.

Leo puts his pencil in its case. The lid closes with a small click. Ronan hears it and moves his hand away from the story.

Miss Wu comes down their row.

“Ready?”

Ronan nods. He passes his page to her. The first answer stays as it is.

Outside at break, Jun asks about the title.

“No picture,” he says.

“We could draw one,” Leo says.

Ronan finds a piece of old paper. He draws the kite high above the field. Leo draws the dog with one ear much larger than the other.

“It will fall over,” Jun says.

“It listens more on this side.”

Jun draws a very small fence. Ronan puts two children beside it. He gives one a blue line and one a red line.

His pencil stops beside the red one.

“The gate goes there,” Leo says.

Ronan draws it. He does not ask about the first question.

They play with the cloth ball until the bell. Ronan laughs when the ball rolls between Leo's feet.

Inside, Miss Wu puts the reading pages in a folder. She does not read out names or give places.

Ronan watches the folder close. Then he takes out his number book with the rest of the class.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

fence＝篱笆；loose＝松开的；ahead＝在前面；folder＝文件夹。

## 理解问题

1. 故事中谁先在场地门口等？
2. Ronan交卷前为什么没有重新检查第一问？

## 读句子

The girl / goes ahead.＝女孩／先往前走。
